prompt:
Create one landscape 3:2 Minecraft architectural MOOD BOARD on a plain warm light background, titled "PIKE PLACE • HOTELS & BRICK BLOCKS". Crisp vanilla Minecraft voxel geometry and recognizable default block textures only, Minecraft Java 1.21.1 blocks only, no characters or animals. This is a public server build catalog at 1.4 blocks/metre, exterior only, dusk lighting with amber windows and shopfronts. Save the generated image as an image artifact.

Layout: upper two thirds contain THREE small complete ensemble thumbnail takes, each showing ALL SIX named buildings as separate numbered models in a coherent architectural study, with subtly different roof/parapet articulation, bay-window rhythms and terracing, retaining the identity and storey counts of each real building. Label takes "A • MASSING", "B • ROOFS", "C • DUSK". Do not merge the six buildings into one invented building. Each take shows: 0 INN AT THE MARKET, four-storey cream stucco hotel enclosing a courtyard, projecting bay windows, flat roof and bay-facing rooftop deck, cafe awnings; 1 101 STEWART, taller 1980s office tower of red brick and beige panels, horizontal ribbon windows and a stepped terraced top, retail base; 2 PALIHOTEL, five-storey Edwardian red-brick hotel, stacked projecting bays, projecting gray sheet-metal cornice represented by iron/stone slabs, glowing vertical PALIHOTEL blade sign, ground shops; 3 THE FIX, five-storey red-brown brick warehouse apartments, broad multi-pane window grid, stepped parapet and dark metal zigzag fire escapes; 4 HAHN BUILDING, compact three-storey red brick, strong cornice, shopfronts and a clearly lettered GREEN TORTOISE hostel sign; 5 PIKE STREET COMMERCIAL, low two-storey brick and pale terracotta-trim commercial block, large shop windows and a glowing neon-style sign band built with vanilla luminous blocks and signs.

Site constraints shown by a small axis legend: west/bay = low x, east/uphill/1st Avenue = high x, northwest = low z, Pike Street = high z. Keep every model in this fixed orientation in all three takes, vary camera only, no turning or mirroring modules. Irregular clipped stair-step footprints, only footprint cells support buildings, each source map cell represents 2x2 blocks. Foundations follow stepped terrain and reach ground, with extra exposed lower floors on the downhill low-x side, especially THE FIX (ground rises 0 to 22 blocks); never float or bury facades. Inn ground rises 0–9, other models 0–4. Local plot envelopes and target roof heights in blocks: Inn 61x54 roof 41; 101 Stewart 64x73 roof 72; Palihotel 59x62 roof 30; Fix 65x65 roof 39; Hahn 57x38 roof 23; Commercial 62x62 roof 17. Preserve flat urban rooflines; don't invent pitched medieval roofs. Small caption "SITE ORIENTATION FIXED • 1.4 BLOCKS / m • JAVA 1.21.1".

Across the middle-lower sheet draw an orderly strip of block swatches grouped by role, with exact lowercase namespaced IDs legibly lettered under each cube, allow two lines for long IDs: WALLS: minecraft:bricks, minecraft:smooth_sandstone, minecraft:terracotta; TRIM: minecraft:smooth_quartz, minecraft:stone_brick_slab; ROOF: minecraft:gray_concrete, minecraft:smooth_stone_slab; WINDOWS: minecraft:glass_pane, minecraft:gray_stained_glass_pane; ACCENTS: minecraft:iron_bars, minecraft:dark_oak_trapdoor, minecraft:lantern, minecraft:sea_lantern. These are actual blocks, no modded materials, no pale oak or blocks added after 1.21.1. Neon represented by luminous blocks behind colored glass, not freeform neon tubes.

Bottom row: FOUR generously sized crisp voxel detail callouts with fine leader lines and short labels: "COURTYARD / CAFE" cream Inn bay window above a striped cafe awning and roof deck railing; "BAY / CORNICE / BLADE" Palihotel stacked red-brick bay with slab cornice and lit PALIHOTEL blade; "WAREHOUSE / FIRE ESCAPE" Fix large mullioned window with iron-bar landing and zigzag stairs, stepped downhill foundation visible; "PIKE STREET / SIGNS" Hahn GREEN TORTOISE sign and cornice paired with adjacent two-storey commercial shop glazing and luminous sign band. Warm dusk glow localized to windows and lamps while sheet background stays plain light. Refined balanced catalog composition, clean readable lettering, sharp block edges, no people, no animals, no interiors except shallow lit displays behind glass, no photorealistic materials, no code, no watermark.
reads: Inn at the Market: cream walls, projecting bay windows, rooftop deck and striped cafe awnings.
101 Stewart: the tallest brick-and-beige mass, with horizontal windows and a terraced crown.
Palihotel: red brick, stacked bays, projecting gray cornice and an illuminated vertical blade sign.
The Fix: broad warehouse window grids, stepped parapet and zigzag metal fire escapes.
Hahn Building: compact brick frontage, strong cornice and green GREEN TORTOISE hostel sign.
Pike Street Commercial: low brick-and-pale-trim frontage, large display windows and a luminous sign band.
Stepped masonry foundations express the downhill grade, especially beneath The Fix.
Warm windows, lanterns and glowing storefronts establish the dusk atmosphere.
Three ensemble studies, a labeled block palette and four enlarged detail panels form the board saved as moodboard.png.
